chapter.verse: Jakeh’ tapa Agur’ thugente. Hih mi lianpa in, “Pasian aw, ka lunggim a, ka cih nading ka thei kei hi.
Ka hai lua a, mihing ka sun kei hi. Mihing bangin ngaihsut siamna ka nei kei hi.
Pilna thu ka thei kei a, Pasian’ thu ka theih om lo hi.

Vantungah kua kah to a, leitungah hong kumsuk kik ahi hiam? Kua in a khut sungah huihte lomcip a, puanin tuite tuncip ahi hiam? Kua in leitung bulpite phut kip ahi hiam? Tua bang mi na theih ngei leh, a tapa’ min bang ahi hiam?
Pasian in a thugen khempeuh a manna laktel a, amah a belte khempeuh tungah kidalna lum ahi hi.
Ama gen lohpi behlap sak kei in; na tua cih leh amah in nang hong tai-in, thuzuau gen na hihna hong kilang ding hi,” a ci hi.
Pasian aw, thu nam nih kong ngen hi. Ka sih ma-in tuate hong pia in.
Zuauna leh khemna ka zat loh nadingin hong huh in la, a hau lua lo, a zawng lua loin hong bawl in la, ka khamkhop zah lian bek an hong pia in.
Hau lua leng, nang hong nialin, “ Topa i cih kua hiam?” kong ci kha ding a, zawng lua leuleu leng, mi’ na guk sakin, ka Pasian’ min kong daisak kha zel ding hi.
A topa kiangah sila khat gensia kei in; amah in nang hong gensia-in, gimna na thuak kha ding hi.
A pate samsia-in a min a dai sak a, nute a phat lo mi pawlkhat om hi.
Amaute a nin mahmah kim lai hi napi-in, amau’ muhna-ah siang a kisa mahmah mi pawlkhat om hi.
Mihoih pha mahmah-a a kingaihsun, a kiliansak mi pawlkhat om hi.
A ha uh namsau tawh a kibang, a ha uh temta tawh a kibang, gam sunga mizawngte a netum, mi cimawhte a liaktum mi pawlkhat om hi.
Vot in tanu nih nei a, khat in, “Hong pia in,” ci a, a khat in zong, “Hong pia in,” mah ci veve hi. “Pha zo ta,” a ci ngei lo thum om a, eh! li hizaw:
Han khuk, taciing numei, tui a deih tawntung leikeu, leh a kisumit zo lo meikuang ahi uh hi.
A pa a simmawh mipa, a nu’ thu a mang nuam lo mipa, va-ak in a mittang khel khiatsakin, musanete in a sa ne ding uh hi.
Ka theih zawh het loh a lamdang mahmah thu thum om a, eh! li hizaw:
van-ah musane a leen’ theihna zia, suangpi tungah gul a pai theihna zia, tuipi tungah teembaw a pai theihna zia leh nungak leh tangval a kingaihna zia ahi hi.
A citak lo zi in hih bangin gamta hi: Midang tawh khialin, tua ciangin kisilsiang a, “Bangmah khialhna gamta ke’ng,” ci khem hi.
Leitungmi khempeuh in a thuak zawh loh thu thum, eh! thu li om a,
sila khat kumpi a suah ciang, a hai khat in a duh bangbang a nek zawh ciang,
a muhthadahhuai numei khat in pasal a neih ciang, nasem numeino in a tonu’ za a suan ciang ahi hi.
A neu mahmah ganhing nam li leitungah om a, ahi zongin a pilpen pente ahi uh hi.
Miksite: a hat het lo ganhing hi napi-in, khuakhal sunga a nek ding khol zo uh hi.
Ngalvangte: a thahat lo ganhing hi napi-in, suang lakah a kua ding uh bawl zo uh hi.
Kauphete: kumpi nei lo napi-in, a kituak diamdiamin hon tat thei uh hi.
Innhikte: khut sunga tawi zawh ganhing hi lel napi-in, kumpi inn sungah teeng zo uh hi.
A gamtatna i et ciangin a thupi suak mahmah thum, eh! li om a,
Ganhing lak pan a hatpen, kuamah a kihta lo humpinelkai,
a kihihsak pai kuahkuah aklui, a kihihsak pai gangan keetal, a mite mai-ah a pai lanlan kumpipa ahi hi.
Kiphasakin na haipau ngei a, thusia bawl ding na ngaihsut ngei khak leh, lim takin thu ngaihsun pha in!
Bawngnawi, meekmeek lehang thawhbat hong suak a, mi khat a nak tupsak lehang si hong luang a, mi phin lehang kitotna hong piang hi.
